subject: Nimbus Health — CSA/CAIQ questionnaire package and questions
messages:

To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ export + supporting artifacts for Nimbus evaluation

Rafael —

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's architecture last week. Attached is our completed CAIQ spreadsheet template with questions marked where we need clarifications. We've also requested a couple of supporting artifacts (network diagram, SOC2 summary) listed in the sheet.

Please confirm whether the attached responses are sufficient for our security review or if your team needs additional artifacts (audit logs, KMS configuration, etc.). We're trying to close the security review by 12/10.

Attachments: nimbus_caiq_questions_20261130.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Ava Collins
Security Program Manager
Nimbus Health


From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ export + supporting artifacts for Nimbus evaluation

Ava —

Appreciate the clean CAIQ file and the target timeline. I'm looping in Neha (our compliance lead) to coordinate the artifacts and call out which questions are already covered by our SOC 2 report and which will need supplementary evidence. Ill put together a package for you with an owner and ETA for each item.

Quick clarifications from our side after a quick pass:
- There are a few controls where you asked about network segmentation between tenant workloads and control plane — we'll attach an updated network diagram and a short note on our VPC design.
- For KMS rotation and key custody, Neha will produce the policy excerpt and the rotation schedule.
- For sample access logs we can provide an anonymized excerpt and a brief explanation of our retention policy.

I'll aim to get the first-pass package to you by EOD 12/03. If you need anything faster, tell me which controls are blocking your review and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes | Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@nimbushealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 17:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ export + supporting artifacts for Nimbus evaluation

Hi Ava / Rafael —

Attached is the initial package we discussed: a completed CAIQ responses workbook (tabbed: responses, control-mapping, artifacts), SOC 2 summary (redacted), network architecture PNG, KMS rotation policy excerpt, and a small sample of access logs with PII removed.

I've also added an annotation column in the CAIQ workbook indicating: 1) the control statement, 2) whether the evidence comes from SOC 2, internal policy, or operational logs, and 3) the file name of the artifact. Highlights:
- Controls related to Identity & Access Management (IAM) are covered by our IAM policy + audit logs (see access-logs-sample-202611.zip).
- Encryption at-rest and in-transit: covered by SOC 2 and KMS policy excerpt.
- Multi-tenant isolation and network controls: see network-architecture-v2.png and the short note in the "control-mapping" tab.

Attachments: redwood_nimbus_caiq_responses_v3.xlsx (xlsx), soc2-summary-2026Q3.pdf (pdf), network-architecture-v2.png (png), kms-key-rotation-policy.txt (txt), access-logs-sample-202611.zip (zip)

If anything in the workbook looks incomplete for your auditors, flag the control IDs and we'll provide expanded artifacts or an auditor-friendly statement.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@nimbushealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@nimbushealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ export + supporting artifacts for Nimbus evaluation

Neha —

Thank you, this is very helpful and much of it aligns with what our security reviewers asked for. A couple quick asks after an internal pass:
1) Can you provide a one-page attestation for control CCM-06 (Key lifecycle) that our procurement team can file?
2) For the sample access logs, can you confirm the UTC timestamps and whether the logs include service-account activity vs. end-user activity?
3) We'll want the network diagram with a short legend called out for the segments you referenced.

If you can send the attestation + updated diagram by EOD 12/08 we should be on track to finish the security gate.

Best,
Ava Collins
Security Program Manager
Nimbus Health

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@nimbushealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 15:48:00 -0800

Ava —

Copy — I'm putting together the CCM-06 attestation (short form) and will regenerate the network diagram with an annotated legend. The access logs sample contains both service-account and end-user events; I'll add a short note in the bundle indicating which entries correspond to which actor type and confirm all timestamps are in UTC.

Expect a deliverable bundle from us (attestation + updated PNG + one-paragraph log key) by 12/08 EOD. I'll upload to the Drive link Rafael provided for your team and drop a HubSpot note referencing HS-34921.

Regards,
